title: Object Storage: put request rate
content:
Object Storage put request rate is defined as follows: PUT, COPY and LIST processing; USD per thousand operations.

| Contract tier | Put request rate |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | put request rate: 0.0052 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | put request rate: 0.0052 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | put request rate: 0.0052 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | put request rate: 0.0052 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | put request rate: 0.0052 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | put request rate: 0.0052 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the put request rate entry is 0.0052.
